description: This file defines the DataGroup entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including its properties, ORM mappings, and getter/setter methods. It models a data group with attributes such as name, description, and permissions, and relations to permissions collections.

classes.name: DataGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing a data group with properties for its attributes and permissions, mapped to the 'ohrm_data_group' database table.
